summary.label: replay_ledger_B
summary.content_preview:
We need to output JSON with runId, summary, allowedFiles list, operations array.

We need to create a file path for src/ledger/ledger.js (update_file because it exists) with appropriate content to fix applyPayment to reject Infinity and keep finite amounts, and also reject NaN? The spec says "rejects Infinity amounts (returns false) and keeps finite amounts." So we need to check that amount is a f
summary.final_preview:
{
  "runId": "replay-ledger-1",
  "summary": "Fix applyPayment to reject Infinity and keep finite amounts; add test",
  "allowedFiles": [
    "src/ledger/ledger.js",
    "src/ledger/ledger.test.js"
  ],
  "operations": [
    {
      "type": "update_file",
      "path": "src/ledger/ledger.js",
      "content": "export function applyPayment(amount) {\n  // Reject non‑finite amounts (e.g., Infinity) and keep only finite numbers\n  if (typeof amount !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(amount)) {\n    return false;\n  }\n  // Additional guard for null/undefined (though Number.isFinite catches them)\n

messages.content: You generate a worker plan JSON object only: {runId, summary, allowedFiles, operations:[{type: create_file|update_file|append_file, path, content, reason}]}. Never write files yourself, never run shell, never approve release. JSON only. Include complete file contents. allowedFiles must list every operation path. Use update_file when the path already exists and create_file only for new paths. Match package.json test runner: node --test.
